title: Homestyle Mediterranean Pasta
description: Cultured, shaggy, and perfect for a date night, this Mediterranean pasta dish features currants in a rich pasta-water emulsion, making it a delicious and satisfying meal. This dish is also shojin-friendly, allowing you to enjoy the flavors without any animal products.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-protein pasta option for added nutrition.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a depth of flavor without overpowering the dish.

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds a bright, tangy flavor.

ingredients.name: currants
ingredients.notes: Dried currants add natural sweetness and chewiness to the dish.

ingredients.name: pine nuts
ingredients.notes: Pine nuts add crunch and a nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: dried oregano
ingredients.notes: Dried oregano adds a familiar herbal flavor.

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: A pinch of red pepper flakes adds a subtle kick of heat.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper enhances the flavors of the dish.

ingredients.name: vegan parmesan cheese
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality, dairy-free parmesan cheese option.

ingredients.name: chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Fresh parsley adds a bright, fresh flavor and color.

ingredients.name: pasta water
ingredients.notes: The pasta water is used to make the emulsion for the sauce.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: Additional water is used to thin out the sauce if needed.

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Reserve 2 cups of pasta water before draining the pasta.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice, currants, pine nuts, dried oregano, and red pepper flakes.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the currants have rehydrated and the sauce has thickened.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, stirring to combine with the sauce.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with vegan parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
